payload.title: Reading LiPD formatted datasets with `PyLiPD`
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to use the `PyLiPD` Python package to read, manipulate, and write LiPD formatted datasets. It covers loading datasets from local files, URLs, directories, and a remote graph database. The notebook also explains how to load datasets in parallel and merge multiple LiPD objects. The primary focus is on handling paleoclimate data efficiently using object-oriented programming.
goals: Open LiPD formatted datasets from a local copy, web URL, or LipdGraph database.
Add more LiPD datasets to an existing object.
